title: LLM Notes handoff package (v1)
description: One reviewed draft (or set of drafts) written to the outbox by RAG Workspace Manager for another system to act on. The app never calls the destination itself; a separate connector reads these files. Unknown values are empty strings, never guesses.

id.description: Unique package id. Connectors must treat it as an idempotency key: processing the same id twice must not create duplicate records.

created.description: Local time the package was sent, ISO 8601.

item_type.description: Every entry in items has this type.

library.description: Corpus display name, e.g. the notes folder name.

library_key.description: Sanitised library name used by the app's index.

question.description: The question asked, or empty if the task ran on its own.

model.description: Ollama model that drafted the items.

notes.description: Source notes the drafts were written from.

path.description: Absolute path on the machine that sent the package, if known.

related_to.description: Name hint for the record this belongs to. Connectors resolve it to an ID (e.g. a Salesforce Opportunity); the app never knows IDs.

name.description: e.g. 'Acme pilot', or empty if unknown.

due_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty if the notes give no date.

owner.description: Person responsible as named in the notes, or empty.

to.description: Recipient names or addresses as given in the notes.
